products.name: DJI Osmo Mobile 6
products.audience: phone filmmakers who walk while they shoot and want steady footage without carrying a rig

image.alt: DJI Osmo Mobile 6 gimbal holding a smartphone in landscape orientation

known_pros: Extension rod is built in, so there is nothing extra to pack
Magnetic clamp makes swapping the phone on and off fast
Side wheel controls zoom or focus without touching the screen
known_cons: Needs the DJI Mimo app for tracking, so features depend on app support for your phone
Heavier phones with thick cases can sit close to the payload limit
